# María Fernández
**Supply Chain Coordinator** · Buenos Aires, Argentina · Hybrid / open to relocation within LATAM\
+54 11 5555 0000 · maria.fernandez@example.com · linkedin.com/in/mariafernandez

## Summary
Supply chain coordinator with 9 years across warehousing, freight and inventory control in consumer goods distribution. Cut lead times 37% and shrinkage 31% at a 3-DC network by pairing WMS adoption with floor-team retraining. Comfortable owning carrier negotiation, S&OP inputs and the reporting layer that keeps regional managers honest.

## Skills
- **Systems:** SAP MM/WM, Oracle WMS, Power BI, Excel (Power Query, pivot modelling), Tableau
- **Methods:** Lean warehousing, cycle counting, ABC analysis, S&OP, DIFOT tracking, Six Sigma (Green Belt)
- **Operations:** carrier negotiation, customs documentation (Mercosur), cold-chain handling, 3PL management
- **Languages:** Spanish (native), English (C1), Portuguese (B2)

## Work Experience
### Supply Chain Coordinator — Acme Logistics S.A.
*Buenos Aires, AR · 03/2021 – Present*

- Cut order-to-ship lead time from 6.2 to 3.9 days across 3 distribution centres by redesigning the pick-pack sequence and retraining a 14-person floor team.
- Reduced inventory shrinkage 31% (USD 210k/yr) by introducing cycle counting on A-class SKUs and a weekly variance review with finance.
- Negotiated carrier contracts covering 1,800 monthly shipments, lowering freight cost per pallet 12% while holding on-time delivery at 97%.
- Implemented WMS (Warehouse Management System) barcode receiving for 4,000 SKUs, eliminating 95% of manual entry errors within two quarters.
- Built a Power BI dashboard tracking fill rate, DIFOT and stock cover for 6 regional managers, replacing a 40-tab weekly spreadsheet.
